title: QuickBooks Online bank CSV, 3-column layout (one row)
description: One transaction row of a CSV file for QuickBooks Online's manual bank upload, 3-column layout: Date, Description, Amount. Money out is negative, money in is positive. Header row must read exactly Date,Description,Amount.

Date.description: Transaction date. One format for the whole file. This spec uses MM/DD/YYYY (U.S.) or DD/MM/YYYY; no weekday text.

Description.description: Payee or memo text as printed on the statement. Not only digits.

Amount.description: Signed amount, digits and a decimal point only. No currency symbol, thousands separator or parentheses. Not zero.
